decision.rationale: The analysis identifies a retention gap in high-interest categories like Furniture. By switching to a 'ranked_discovery' campaign with an 'adaptive' forecast and 'joint' objective, we can better capture and nurture shoppers who require longer cycles to complete purchases. The selected 'Response Hurdle' model (V2-MODEL-3f79e7bf1623) will be used to prioritize these high-value, long-term shoppers, improving overall retention while protecting merchant contribution.
